description: This file defines the SugarSQLValidate class, which provides methods to validate and parse SQL query clauses to prevent malicious or unsafe SQL modifications, focusing on validating WHERE and ORDER BY clauses in SQL statements within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: SugarSQLValidate
classes.description: A class responsible for validating SQL query clauses to ensure safety and correctness, primarily used for security validation of user-inputted SQL clauses in the SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: validateQueryClauses
methods.description: Validates the WHERE and ORDER BY clauses of an SQL query string to ensure they do not contain unsafe constructs.

methods.name: validateExpression
methods.description: Recursively inspects parsed SQL expression trees to prohibit dangerous functions, subqueries (except allowed), and unsafe column references.

methods.name: allowedSubquery
methods.description: Determines if a subquery structure is permitted based on specific allowed tables and structure.

methods.name: validateColumnName
methods.description: Checks if a column name is safe by preventing usage of forbidden columns like 'user_hash' and ensuring valid characters.
